notes: src is NOT a download: build it first with tools/jt-fit/prep_a.py (job ship-masts) from GalleonOGA.blend into a scratch dir and pass that dir as the src dir (it gives the untextured ship a material, turns it broadside and squashes it front to back). The hull, castles, bowsprit and foremast cropped away: what is left is the main and mizzen masts with their pennants and (set, not furled - the source has no furled sails) sails seen edge-on, painted dark wood. Fitted on h: 8.0 high comes out 5.7 wide (two masts at the galleon's spacing cannot fit 3.1; the main mast alone would be 1.4).
